subject: aerospace

resources.title: 16.00 Introduction to Aerospace Engineering and Design
resources.notes: Hands-on introductory aerospace course with problem sets, written assignments and a team lighter-than-air vehicle design/build/fly project with design reviews.

resources.title: 16.100 Aerodynamics
resources.notes: Undergraduate aerodynamics instruction with lecture notes, problem sets and examination materials.

resources.title: 16.21 Techniques for Structural Analysis and Design
resources.notes: Aerospace structural mechanics and design course with nine problem sets, lecture notes, a midterm and final examination materials.

resources.title: 16.30 Estimation and Control of Aerospace Systems
resources.notes: Aerospace estimation, avionics and guidance/control instruction with lecture notes, problem sets, solutions, quiz and final examination.

resources.title: 16.50 Introduction to Propulsion Systems
resources.notes: Undergraduate propulsion course with lecture notes, ten homework sets and solutions, midterm and comprehensive final materials.

resources.title: MIT OpenCourseWare Aeronautics and Astronautics Collection
resources.notes: Discovery collection only; individual courses must be verified and mapped before they count as instructional evidence.

resources.title: NASA Technical Reports Server
resources.notes: Research repository; records require item-level provenance and rights verification and do not by themselves establish instructional or expert competence.

known_gaps: Dedicated orbital-mechanics curriculum should be verified and added rather than inferred from the broad MIT collection.
Uncrewed aerial systems remains thin and needs dedicated flight, autonomy, safety and systems instruction.
Graduate spacecraft design and space-systems project coverage should be strengthened with exact assessed course evidence.

Expert readiness requires practical design/build/test work, simulation, verification and validation, working runtime retrieval, citations and passed assessment; catalog and research coverage alone are insufficient.
rights_note: Preserve FAA, NASA and MIT provenance and applicable license or public-domain status. Verify rights at item level before local full-text ingestion.
